return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.c-entry-box--compact, .c-entry-box--compact__body, article')).slice(0, 20).map(el => ({ title: el.querySelector('h2, h3, .c-entry-box--compact__title')?.innerText?.trim(), url: el.querySelector('a')?.href, summary: el.querySelector('.c-entry-box--compact__dek, p')?.innerText?.trim(), image: el.querySelector('img')?.src })).filter(x => x.title && x.title.length > 10);

return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.tease, article, .article')).slice(0, 20).map(el => ({ title: el.querySelector('h2, h3, .headline')?.innerText?.trim(), url: el.querySelector('a')?.href, summary: el.querySelector('.excerpt, .summary, p')?.innerText?.trim(), image: el.querySelector('img')?.src })).filter(x => x.title && x.title.length > 10);
